spec:

  pages:

            - id: denial-reason-text

        - id: parties

          fields:
            - id: patient-name
              name: patient_name
              label: Patient Name
              description: Patient name
              dataType: string
              widget: text
            - id: payer-name
              name: payer_name
              label: Payer Name

            - id: servicing-provider-name

              label: Servicing Provider Name
              description: Servicing provider name

              label: Medication Name

          description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
          fields:
            - id: request-status
              name: request_status
              label: Request Status
              description: Requested | Approved | Denied | Pending | Partially_Approved | Expired
              dataType: string
              widget: text
  validationRules:
    - id: authorization-id-required
      severity: error
      description: Authorization ID is the primary key for payer utilization management tracking.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: authorization_id
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: authorization_id
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: authorization_id IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(authorization_id)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: request-status-valid
      severity: warning
      description: Prior authorization workflow routing depends on a recognized request status.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: request_status
            right:
              value: Requested
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: request_status
            right:
              value: Approved
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: request_status
            right:
              value: Denied
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: request_status
            right:
              value: Pending
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: request_status
            right:
              value: Partially_Approved
          - op: eq
            left:
              field: request_status
            right:
              value: Expired
      sourceExpression: request_status IN ('Requested', 'Approved', 'Denied', 'Pending', 'Partially_Approved', 'Expired')
      supported: true
    - id: member-id-present
      severity: error
      description: Member ID is required to reconcile the authorization with payer eligibility and claims.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: patient_member_id
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: patient_member_id
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: patient_member_id IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(patient_member_id)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: provider-npi-format
      severity: warning
      description: Requesting provider NPI should be a ten digit numeric identifier.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: requesting_provider_npi
          - op: matches
            left:
              field: requesting_provider_npi
            pattern: ^[0-9]{10}$
      sourceExpression: requesting_provider_npi IS NULL OR requesting_provider_npi REGEXP '^[0-9]{10}$'
      supported: true
    - id: denial-reason-required-for-denials
      severity: warning
      description: Denied prior authorizations need denial rationale to support appeals workflow.
      rule:
        op: not
        rule:
          op: and
          rules:
            - op: eq
              left:
                field: request_status
              right:
                value: Denied
            - op: not
              rule:
                op: present
                field: denial_reason_text
      sourceExpression: NOT (request_status = 'Denied' AND denial_reason_text IS NULL)
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      authorization_id:
        minConfidence: 0.94
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Authorization ID links the request to payer decisions, claim edits, and appeals.
      request_status:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Status determines whether the downstream workflow releases, appeals, or holds care.
      patient_member_id:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Member ID is required for eligibility, payer lookup, and claims matching.
      requesting_provider_npi:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: Provider NPI identifies the ordering clinician or organization.
      procedure_codes:
        minConfidence: 0.9
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: true
        rationale: CPT/HCPCS codes define the requested service and payer coverage rules.
      denial_reason_text:
        minConfidence: 0.82
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Denial rationale is required for appeal packet preparation.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-gemini-flash
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-dbrx-instruct
    maxTokens: 4096
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Prior authorization packets mix structured forms, payer letters, checkboxes, stamps, and clinical
      attachments. Gemini Flash is preferred for scanned packets; DBRX Instruct can process digitally native
      payer letters.
  submissionSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      authorization_id:
        type: string
        description: Authorization id
      request_status:
        type: string
        description: Requested | Approved | Denied | Pending | Partially_Approved | Expired
      request_date:
        type: date
        description: Request date
        format: date
      decision_date:
        type: date
        description: Decision date
        format: date
      expiration_date:
        type: date
        description: Expiration date
        format: date
      patient_name:
        type: string
        description: Patient name
      patient_dob:
        type: string
        description: Patient dob
      patient_member_id:
        type: string
        description: Patient member id
      payer_name:
        type: string
        description: Payer name
      plan_name:
        type: string
        description: Plan name
      requesting_provider_name:
        type: string
        description: Requesting provider name
      requesting_provider_npi:
        type: string
        description: Requesting provider npi
      servicing_provider_name:
        type: string
        description: Servicing provider name
      servicing_provider_npi:
        type: string
        description: Servicing provider npi
      diagnosis_codes:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Diagnosis codes
      procedure_codes:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Procedure codes
      medication_name:
        type: string
        description: Medication name
      service_description:
        type: string
        description: Service description
      units_requested:
        type: string
        description: Units requested
      units_approved:
        type: string
        description: Units approved
      place_of_service:
        type: string
        description: Place of service
      denial_reason_code:
        type: string
        description: Denial reason code
      denial_reason_text:
        type: string
        description: Denial reason text
      appeal_deadline:
        type: string
        description: Appeal deadline
      clinical_criteria_referenced:
        type: string
        description: Clinical criteria referenced
    required:
      - authorization_id
      - patient_member_id
    additionalProperties: false
    x-ladder-docubricks:
      completenessChecklist:
        - id: required_fields_present
          description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
          fields:
            - authorization_id
            - patient_member_id
        - id: section_coverage_reviewed
          description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
          sections:
            - dates_and_terms
            - document_details
            - parties
            - risk_and_compliance
        - id: nested_lists_normalized
          description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
          fields: []
